chunks: So to that (law) you should call them, and be constant as commanded. Do not follow their passing whims, but say: 'I believe in whatever Scripture God has revealed, and I am commanded to act with equivalence among you. God is our Lord and your Lord. To us our actions, to you your deeds. There is no dispute between you and us. God will gather us all together, and to Him is our returning.'

key_terms.لِأَعْدِلَ بَيْنَكُمُ: to act with equivalence among you

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'La hujjata baynana wa baynakum' in Surah Ash-Shura?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the Prophet's authority to define the core tenets of faith while maintaining political and theological neutrality regarding the specific interpretations of various sects. The phrase 'I have been commanded to be just between you' is often interpreted as a mandate for equitable governance and the preservation of unity amidst diversity, reflecting the Imamate's role in guiding the community without imposing a single rigid dogmatic view on all matters. This underscores the principle that ultimate judgment belongs to God, allowing for a pluralistic yet cohesive Islamic identity.
